description: Query the live physical synthesis status, geometric DRC completion telemetry, unlock state, and payment instructions for an existing job_id. Call this read-only polling tool after calligraphy_compile_board or after a human completes Stripe/Coinbase checkout to check whether unlocked is true. Requires job_id (string). Returns JSON with status ('PAID_AND_UNLOCKED', 'COMPLETED_AWAITING_PAYMENT', or 'INCOMPLETE_NOT_PAYABLE'), geometry_status, unconnected_count, drc_errors, final_price_usd, clickable_stripe_checkout_url, stablecoin_payment_instructions, and agentic_crypto_payment; if KeyError is returned, verify the job_id string from calligraphy_compile_board.

job_id.description: Unique synthesis job identifier returned by calligraphy_compile_board or calligraphy_route_pcb. Example: 'job_a1b2c3d4'.

name: calligraphy_get_job_status
title: Get PCB Synthesis Job Status
